Motorboat carrying 15 Home Guard jawans capsizes in Narmada river in Jabalpur

A motorboat carrying 15 Home Guard jawans capsized in the Narmada river near Gwarighat in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh. The incident occurred when the boat's engine failed mid-stream, causing it to be swept away by the strong current. All 15 personnel were wearing life jackets, and local boatmen were able to rescue them in time. The boat was reportedly on patrol when the engine malfunctioned.
